changes.old_behavior: vendor_code_rules and subsystem tokens (e.g., qcom/msm/dt-binding) could contribute to blocking decisions.
changes.new_behavior: All subsystem/vendor indicators are moved to subsystem_context section with weight 0.0 and severity INFO only.

changes.old_behavior: Binary OR: any one blocking pattern caused case-level blocking.
changes.new_behavior: Weighted threshold scoring with explicit pattern weights and calibrated threshold.
changes.why: Reduces over-triggering from generic pattern hits.

changes.old_behavior: Question-style requirement comments remained question class and were excluded from objection extraction.
changes.new_behavior: classify_comment_with_context promotes requirement-style questions to objection in rejected/changes-requested series; Vinod Koul specific patterns added.
changes.why: Recovers false negatives for conversational objection style.

changes.old_behavior: Generic acceptance regex (e.g., "applied") could misclassify objection text such as "could be applied".
changes.new_behavior: Acceptance regex now avoids broad applied/queued tokens and relies on explicit acceptance-email markers plus Ack/Review tags.
changes.why: Prevents false-negative objection classification in changes-requested threads.

changes.old_behavior: Requirement phrases like "I would need s-o-b" were not guaranteed to classify as objection.
changes.why: Captures process/testing objections with conversational wording.

changes.old_behavior: Accepted/mainlined cases with explicit reviewer acceptance could still block from earlier comments.
changes.new_behavior: Case scoring resolves accepted/mainlined cases to non-blocking when reviewer has acceptance-classified comment in-thread.
changes.why: Aligns case-level scoring with final reviewer acceptance signal and reduces false positives.

changes.new_behavior: R3 reuses existing raw artifacts only; no new Patchwork fetches.
changes.why: R3 scope is scoring-model correction, not corpus expansion.
